metadata.oracle_evidence: solution/trajectory.npz: Sharpa Wave rows on the Marvin right arm (2,446 rows; success after 2,346 controls, 100 hold rows of slack), float32-exact. Authored closed loop on the wave-2 wrist stage and followed with the arm by IK (tools/arm_port.py); two fresh-process replays give identical state hashes; no arm, stand or parked-hand contact with the task objects. No Wuji Hand 2.2 reference for the arm rig.

notes.layout: Each row starts with the 14 Marvin arm joint targets (left arm J1-J7, then right arm J1-J7), followed by the left hand's finger targets and then the right hand's (22 per hand for `sharpa`, 20 per hand for `wuji`); the left arm is parked and only the right arm/hand perform the task.
